## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] PR body lacks the "Verified" and "Not changed" lists required by issue AC #5 and PRD AC-PR — PR #4855 body
- Severity: ! (explicit in-scope acceptance criterion unmet)
- Classification / requirement scope: validation gap (deliverable missing); in_pr_scope. Root cause looks like a plan-lowering gap: the xBRIEF spec carries 10 work items (traces list) and no item for AC-PR, so the work agent's checklist never contained it.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: Issue #4826 AC #5: "The PR body lists the facts verified and those skipped." Shared decision rule 1: "If the official page disagrees with this issue, the official page wins, and the PR body says so. If you cannot confirm a fact … list it under 'Not changed (unverified)' in the PR body." PRD AC-PR requires a "Verified" list (each fact with its URL) and a "Not changed" list naming: (a) issue AC #4's 1M window not applied (D1, quoting the code.claude.com sentence), (b) no Codex floor for gpt-6-rosalind / gpt-6-astra-law (D5), (c) no published gpt-5.6-sol post-promo rate, (d) the claude-sonnet-4-5 target kept at claude-sonnet-4-6 although Anthropic recommends claude-sonnet-5-5 (D2).
- Expected / observed / impact: Expected those two lists. Observed: `gh pr view 4855 --json body` shows only the issue link and a 10-line checklist of xBRIEF item titles. Impact: issue AC #4 ("contextWindow equals the window stated by the claude-api skill", i.e. 1M) is visibly unmet in code (still 200000), and nothing on the PR tells the merging operator that this is a deliberate, sourced deviation rather than an incomplete implementation. The same applies to the skipped Codex floors, which issue item 2 asked for ("including any Codex CLI minimum version").
- Evidence: `gh pr view 4855 --json body -q .body`; `gh issue view 4826`; `.pan/drafts/PAN-4826.md` "AC-PR"; `grep -n "AC-PR\|Not changed" .pan/specs/…xbrief.json` finds only rationale text, no item.
- Fix: Edit the PR body (`gh pr edit 4855 --body-file …`); no code change. Add a "Verified" section listing each fact from the PRD's "Verified facts" with its URL, and a "Not changed" section with items (a)–(d) above, quoting for (a): "Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 reach 1M only through their `[1m]` variant, and access to that variant depends on your plan" (code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config). Keep the existing checklist. Spec correction for future plans: the planner should lower PR-body ACs into an xBRIEF item so they reach the work agent's checklist.

## Non-blocking Findings

- `?` [UX] gpt-6-rosalind is offered in both pickers and the Settings catalog to every operator, but OpenAI limits its API access to a trusted-access program and it is absent from the Codex 0.159.0 ChatGPT-sign-in catalog. A typical operator who picks it will get a provider-side rejection at launch rather than an Overdeck preflight refusal, because D5 deliberately adds no Codex floor row. The descriptions do state the restriction, and this follows the issue's "opt-in" rule and PRD D5/D7, so it is advisory. A follow-up could hide or badge trusted-access models.
- `?` [requirements] gpt-6-astra-law is priced at the promotional $10/$1/$50 "through at least 2026-12-31", and gpt-5.6-sol at the promotional $4/$20 "through at least 2026-11-21" (19 days away). Both carry dated comments as the PRD requires; someone needs to revisit them when the promos end. No post-promo rates are published, so nothing more can be done now.
- Intended side effect (PRD D3), confirmed: `tier-table.ts` `knownModelIds()` reads only `PROVIDERS.*.models`, so a tiered-execution config naming `claude-sonnet-4-5` now reports it as unknown. `providers.ts` `knownModelIds()` (UnknownModelError suggestions) and `tier-fitness-context.ts` still know it through `MODEL_DEPRECATIONS` keys and `MODEL_CAPABILITIES` keys, and `getProviderForModel` still resolves it to anthropic (asserted in the new audit test).

### Dimensions

Traced the Codex 272K pin path (`runtimes/codex.ts:296`) and the claude-code policy fallthrough. No other `startsWith`/`includes` prefix matcher in src can misroute the new ids. No defects found.
- Security: Data-only catalog change; no trust boundary, input path, or dependency change. Nothing to report.
- Performance: Static table additions; no runtime cost. Nothing to report.

Non-goals all respected: no [1m] ids, 4.6 windows unchanged, sonnet-4-5 deprecation target unchanged, no tierModels/haikuModel change, no retired-row change, no Codex floor / GPT_56_MODELS / CLIProxy route for new ids, `codex.ts` untouched, no >272K tiers, only OpenAI/Anthropic touched, no changelog.mdx edit, no line growth in the two capped files, no hardcoded fallback.
